name: Female Beauty
overview: Scripture acknowledges female beauty as a notable attribute, exemplified in Esther's physical appearance which was described as fair and beautiful. However, Proverbs emphasizes that outward beauty is fleeting and can be deceptive, urging believers to value a woman who fears the Lord above all. True blessing and joy are found in the intimate and faithful relationship with one's wife, highlighting the importance of godly character over mere external appearance.
